QF.id: Introduction to AML, CFT and Proliferation Financing_11

question.text: Which of the following is NOT a function of FIU-IND?

answer.text: Acting as the central reception point for receiving CTRs and STRs from reporting entities
Analyzing received information to uncover patterns suggesting money laundering
Directly prosecuting individuals involved in money laundering offences
Sharing information with national intelligence and law enforcement agencies

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists FIU-IND's functions as Collection, Analysis, Sharing of information, acting as Central Repository, Coordination, and Research. Direct prosecution is not on that list. The Trap: The other options are all genuine FIU-IND functions per the workbook list, making "directly prosecuting individuals" the odd one out. Note: The workbook page checked supports ED carrying out investigation and enforcement functions; the broader claim about ED and Special Courts handling prosecution end-to-end is not established on the pages checked.
